SPECIFICATION & FORMULA

Calculation Methodology

REFERENCE BASIS: Standard Industry Financial & Technical Formula • ASSUMPTIONS MODEL: 2026-10-27

Reference Notes & FAQ

What net profit margin should an e-commerce store target?

Healthy direct-to-consumer stores typically aim for a 15% to 25% net profit margin after accounting for customer acquisition cost (CPA) and payment fees.

Should refund rates be included in unit economics?

Yes, setting aside 2%–5% for returns and chargebacks prevents overestimating net profit.
